title: Euphoria
synopsis: A group of high school students navigate love and friendships in a world of drugs, sex, trauma, and social media.

bonus.title: in conversation: zendaya and sam levinson

episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.synopsis: Seventeen-year-old Rue returns home from rehab with no plans to stay clean.

episodes.title: Stuntin' Like My Daddy
episodes.synopsis: On the first day of school, Rue has a new friend, Jules, but struggles to put the past behind her.

episodes.title: Made You Look
episodes.synopsis: Kat starts camming. Jules falls for a boy online. Rue is confronted at NA, and Cassie visits McKay at college.

episodes.title: Shook Ones Pt. II
episodes.synopsis: Rue, trying to get clean for Jules, chaperones Gia at the carnival. Jules encounters Cal with his family.

episodes.title: '03 Bonnie and Clyde
episodes.synopsis: Maddy and Nate must deal with a police investigation. Rue and Jules each reflect on their relationship.

episodes.title: The Next Episode
episodes.synopsis: On Halloween, Rue worries about her reliance on Jules when she starts acting strange.

episodes.title: The Trials and Tribulations of Trying to Pee While Depressed
episodes.synopsis: Rue gets depressed and watches 22 straight episodes of a British reality show.​ Jules visits an old friend.

episodes.title: And Salt the Earth Behind You
episodes.synopsis: It's the winter formal at East Highland.

episodes.title: Trying to Get to Heaven Before They Close the Door
episodes.synopsis: Rue and Jules cross paths for the first time since Christmas as East Highland rings in the new year.

episodes.title: Out of Touch
episodes.synopsis: As the new semester kicks off, Jules questions Rue and Elliot’s new friendship, while Cal hunts for answers.

episodes.title: Ruminations: Big and Little Bullys
episodes.synopsis: Rue pursues a new business venture, Cassie settles into a routine, and Cal finds a target.

episodes.title: You Who Cannot See, Think of Those Who Can
episodes.synopsis: Jules and Elliot grow closer, Maddy celebrates her birthday and Cal takes a trip down memory lane.

episodes.title: Stand Still Like the Hummingbird
episodes.synopsis: Fate has a way of catching up with those who try to outrun it.

episodes.title: A Thousand Little Trees of Blood
episodes.synopsis: Rue tries to recover, Lexi questions putting on her play and Nate celebrates his newfound freedom.

episodes.title: The Theater and Its Double
episodes.synopsis: Art imitates life as the East Highland crew watches their complicated dynamics play out onstage.

episodes.title: All My Life, My Heart Has Yearned for a Thing I Cannot Name
episodes.synopsis: As the show goes on, fragments of memories collide with the present and future.

episodes.title: Andale
episodes.synopsis: A few years after high school, Rue's debts finally catch up with her. Hoping to finance her dream wedding, Cassie tries to become internet famous – to the disapproval of Nate, who's juggling the demands of running Cal's business.

episodes.title: America My Dream
episodes.synopsis: Maddy arrived in the city with no money, a suitcase full of clothes, and a plan.

episodes.title: The Ballad of Paladin
episodes.synopsis: While in art school, Jules learns she can fund her dreams by going on dates with rich men. Having worked her way up in Alamo's organization, Rue is sent on a special mission with Bishop. Meanwhile, Cassie's storybook wedding doesn't go as planned.

episodes.title: Kitty Likes to Dance
episodes.synopsis: Rue is offered a risky deal that draws her deeper into Alamo's world. While Nate battles the city council, Maddy gives Cassie a mission that could skyrocket her new career, and Lexi enlists Jules to create an original painting for LA Nights.

episodes.title: This Little Piggy
episodes.synopsis: She would never say it out loud, but Nate going broke finally granted Cassie permission to follow her dreams.

episodes.title: Stand Still and See
episodes.synopsis: Rue makes a deal with the devil in the form of a promise to Alamo...and gives a word of warning to Maddy. Later, Cassie gets her first real taste of stardom on the set of LA Nights, and Rue paints Jules a picture of her ideal future.

episodes.title: Rain or Shine
episodes.synopsis: Under intense financial pressure, Maddy schemes to get Cassie back in the spotlight. Meanwhile, Rue obsesses over the sign God gave her.

episodes.title: In God We Trust
episodes.synopsis: Danger closes in on all sides as Rue's double-dealing finally reaches its breaking point. While the medical van speeds towards the border, Maddy and Cassie must band together – and Alamo is struck by a life-changing epiphany.
